error: A source's confident claim proves its cause
example: A neighbour swore the bread made her ill, so the bread was poisoned, beside: A neighbour reported she was ill after the bread; the report does not show the bread caused it
if_many: Day 4 warm-up for X3, day 6 Return and repair for X5, 5 minutes each: sort four sentences into reported, implied and unproved

error: Naming an event explains its structural effect
example: The story ends because she dies, beside: ending inside the account leaves the reader alone with the claim
if_many: Compare the actual placement with one alternative before saying what changed

error: A plausible meaning needs no contextual clue
example: A grave expression: a place for burial, beside: grave describes the expression, so it means serious
if_many: Day 5 warm-up, 5 minutes: test two senses of a word against one new sentence

error: Related forms have the same grammatical role
example: He felt a great conceivable, beside: conceive (verb), conception (noun), conceivable (adjective)
if_many: Day 8's word-family slot, 3 minutes: substitute the form that fits the clause

error: A guessed definition counts as consulting a reference
example: I know grave means serious, beside: The entry gives adjective, weighty, sober; I copied the line

error: A preliminary inference needs no verification
example: Keeps the first guess, beside: rereads the sentence and keeps or revises it for a stated reason

error: Any shorter sentence preserves the original meaning
example: The fence fell., beside: The fence, which the farmer had mended in spring, fell although the evening had been calm.
if_many: Day 3 warm-up, 5 minutes: tag which fact each clause of a three-clause sentence carries, then recombine without losing one

error: Copying a supplied word list shows independent gathering

error: An opinion needs no prepared textual evidence
example: I just think Brown was crazy, beside: the same claim with a marked passage attached

error: One speaker can impose the group's procedure

error: Repetition is enough to advance discussion
